title: Entity match
description: Decide whether two records are the same entity, or whether a new memory duplicates or updates a stored one

a.description: record A as text, e.g. "name='ACME Corp.', domain='acme.com'"

match.instructions: Do record A and record B describe the same real-world entity? Judge identity, not similarity of wording.
criteria: different: distinct entities (a shared word or name is a coincidence)
related: connected but not identical (parent/subsidiary, same brand but different product, same family)
same: one entity written two ways (abbreviations, legal suffixes, casing, punctuation, transliteration, word order)

combine: same if match >= same_at; different if match <= different_at; related otherwise
limitations: only the pair score is read: the per-field noul questions (auto-merge needs every required field >= 0.85) cannot be generated by the engine, so field checks stay with the caller
only sees the state; middle values mark relatedness, not a rank; uses world knowledge for public entities
notes: # deviation: spec 5.19: records a and b are text (the engine cannot format an object), and there are no per-field questions; related is the closed fallback
